Hi Elena / Tom —

Great to be aligned on the kickoff next week. To make the engineering handoff smooth, can you confirm the items below by EOD Thursday so our infra/security teams can prep the Dedicated staging environment?

Checklist (high level) — please attach where relevant:
- SSO/SAML metadata (EntityID, ACS URL, certificate)
- SCIM scope & group mapping CSV (which groups map to which RBAC roles)
- IP allowlist ranges or preferred NAT IPs for your egress
- Names + owner email for any service accounts you want Redwood to provision or whitelist
- Any org policies that will affect onboarding (e.g., MFA enforcement, IP-based session policies)

I've attached our onboarding checklist to show where we map each item. Once we have SAML + IP list we can schedule the first smoke tests (est 60–90 minutes).

Also: do you prefer us to create managed service accounts inside your SCIM provisioning, or do you want to bring your own service accounts and provide credentials? Either is fine — we just need to agree on rotation policy.

Next steps for us after your confirmation: schedule 90-min technical kickoff (network/SAML/SCIM), create a canary routing window, and lock in rollback criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the thread. A couple of security ops items I want captured before kickoff:

- Default RBAC for managed service accounts: least-privilege; create 'svc-redwood-limited' role that only allows model invocation and metrics read. No token creation or billing actions. If Medinovo requests broader scope, require an approved exception via their security reviewer.
- Rotation: 90-day key rotation is fine. We'll automate rotation and publish rotation events to audit logs (immutable entries).
- SCIM: confirm 15-minute group sync is acceptable. We need explicit mapping for any admin groups to avoid privilege escalation.
- IP allowlist: confirm whether they will allow our healthcheck IPs (we use ephemeral probes from region-us-west-1). If not, we need an alternate health-check strategy.

I recommend we include a 2-hour canary window in staging with a rollback to their previous endpoints and a metrics-based stop condition: token error rate > 1% or P50 latency regression > 30% for 5m.

I'll add these items to ENGINF-1245. If everyone agrees, Hannah please confirm and Ill publish the security checklist to the shared Drive.

-Jonas
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Confirming next steps and timeline:

1) Kickoff: Tue 16 May, 10:00–11:30 PT — technical kickoff (network, SAML, SCIM, service accounts). Calendar invite to follow from Marissa.
2) Staging canary: we will deploy to staging and open a 2-hour canary window using their first NAT range (10.140.32.0/22). Rollback triggers as per Jonass note.
3) SCIM: we will configure a 15-minute group sync and limit admin-group mappings until explicit review. We will test propagation with a sample group during the kickoff.
4) Service accounts: Redwood will provision managed service accounts under Medinovo org, rotate keys every 90 days, and restrict them to 'svc-redwood-limited' role by default. We will supply an ownership CSV for final sign-off.
5) Documentation & sign-off: shared MAP attached (MAP-Medinovo-Redwood-v1.pdf). Procurement — please review and sign via DocuSign (link below) or let us know if you prefer an SOW.
